metadataTitle: Terms of use — Soft Bee Tracker
title: Terms of use
intro: The rules for using Soft Bee Tracker, the internal workspace for logging time, managing projects and preparing reports.
footer: Questions about these terms? Contact your workspace admin or manager.

sections.title: Who can use the workspace
points: Access is limited to Soft Bee team members and contractors who were invited by an admin or manager.
Your account is personal. Do not share your sign-in link, password or session with anyone else.
Admins may change your role or block access when your engagement ends or these terms are breached.

sections.title: Logging time
points: Log time honestly and against the project you actually worked on.
Keep entries up to date; managers rely on them for approvals, invoices and payroll.
Approved entries may be locked. Ask your manager if an approved entry needs a correction.

sections.title: Your data
points: We store the profile details you provide and the time entries you create to run the workspace.
Managers and admins can see your profile, time entries and reports for the projects they manage.
Data is used only for internal planning, reporting, invoicing and payroll.

sections.title: Confidentiality
points: Project, client and financial information in the workspace is confidential.
Do not export, copy or share it outside Soft Bee unless your manager has approved it.

sections.title: Acceptable use
points: Do not try to access data or features your role does not allow.
Do not upload malicious content or attempt to disrupt the service.
Report security issues or suspicious activity to an admin right away.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
points: We may update these terms as the workspace evolves. The date at the top shows the latest revision.
Continuing to use the workspace after an update means you accept the revised terms.
